subject: Staged hotpatch authorization and evacuation ladder for Private clusters
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Staged hotpatch authorization and evacuation ladder for Private clusters

Team —

Summary: we have a critical hotpatch (v1.2.3) addressing a KV-cache corruption seen in a small subset of Private customers. AcmeBank is on the list and has requested an accelerated window. Before we start any window I want to lock the authorization + evacuation ladder and get explicit sign-off for the proposed quiet windows and rollback triggers.

Proposal (high-level):
- Canary group: 3 clusters (two in us-east-1, one in us-west-2).
- Quiet window: 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic) for canary, followed by a 24h observation period before rolling more broadly.
- Version pin policy: we pin worker images for 72h after a successful canary. Pin eviction ladder: canary -> staged 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 30m pause between steps and health checks gating.
- KV cache drain: pre-roll to drain prefix caches, run the drain script packaged in hotpatch-package-v1.2.3.tar.gz (attached).
- Rollback triggers (automated):
  * Service error rate > 3% sustained over 5m OR
  * 95th percentile tail latency increase > 200ms vs baseline for 10m OR
  * Any customer-facing data corruption report (manual immediate rollback).
- Evacuation ladder: if canary hit trigger, do immediate rollback for canary and quarantine the build; if staged rollout hits trigger at 25% we abort further rollout and start staged rollback for all newly upgraded nodes using the rollback-playbook-v1.2.pdf (attached).

Asks:
1) Technical: Rishi / Karthik, confirm KV drain steps and that the rollback script will restore pinned image and KV pointers in <10m for a single node.
2) Ops: Neha, confirm the quiet window aligns with AcmeBank's maintenance SLA and we have NOC coverage for the 02:00–06:00 UTC window (includes post-canary observation).
3) Leadership: Laura, need a quick thumbs-up (or list of objections) before I schedule the canary for Tue 2026-10-27 02:00 UTC.

Attachments: hotpatch-package-v1.2.3.tar.gz (stub), rollback-playbook-v1.2.pdf

Notes: I've uploaded the runbook and the preflight checklist to the drive link and opened INF-4821 for tracking.

Thanks,
Olga
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged hotpatch authorization and evacuation ladder for Private clusters

Olga —

Thanks for the clear plan. A few clarifications from ops/comms:
- The proposed 02:00–04:00 UTC canary window is fine for AcmeBank (I checked with Peter Lang). We should extend NOC coverage until 06:00 UTC for observation and a short rollback window.
- SLA note: because AcmeBank has a reserved capacity contract, procurement expects a 4-hour advanced notice for any maintenance that can impact throughput; Pete confirmed he's OK with a 24-hour heads-up if we keep the quiet window. I'll prepare the customer maintenance email template.
- Can we add a throttling valve in the staging step that prevents more than 5 concurrent node restarts per region? That reduces blast radius if we see slow reboots.

I'll coordinate the customer communication and include the updated timeline once we have leadership sign-off. One small ask: add an entry in the runbook to capture audit-log IDs for telemetry sent to AcmeBank for the patch window.

-neha
Senior Manager, Platform Ops
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged hotpatch authorization and evacuation ladder for Private clusters

Olga / team —

Technical confirmations and changes:
- KV drain: I've validated the drain script on a test cluster. Typical node drain + restart with KV pointer reconciliation is ~7–9 minutes under load for a standard 16xG4 instance. The script is idempotent but we must guard against concurrent runs per node.
- Rollback automation: rollback-playbook-v1.2.pdf contains the automated rollback hooks. If trigger threshold is met we can full-automate rollback for nodes that have completed upgrade; partial upgrades will be rolled back in reverse order of the upgrade queue.
- Metrics gating: change the error-rate gate to 3% (sustained 5m) and add a second gating condition: customer 99th percentile request failure for any single tenant > 1% for 5m. This protects individual customers like AcmeBank even if cluster-level metrics look okay.
- Capacity reservation: we need to reserve ~10% spare capacity in each AZ for safe rollbacks. Karthik, can you confirm autoscaler will respect a temporary reservation flag during the maintenance window?

I'll attach a quick test log and the small patch smoke-run results to INF-4821.

—rishi
Director, Serving Infrastructure

Olga —

Thanks for the concise plan and for surfacing the ops/metric changes. Approve with two conditions:
1) Add the 5-concurrent-node restart throttle (Neha's suggestion) to the runbook and enforce it during 25% and 50% steps.
2) Escalation flow: if AcmeBank files a P1 or we see any evidence of corruption, notify me immediately and trigger an unscheduled rollback; do not wait for the 5m sustained window for customer-impacting corruption.

Assuming those conditions are in the runbook I'll greenlight the canary for Tue 2026-10-27 02:00 UTC. Please paste the final runbook link to this thread after Neha updates it and I will confirm the final go/no-go 2 hours before the window.
